about.title: About me
about.name: Abel Destinée Idowu
about.body: For several years I've helped homeowners, contractors, and developers build better while spending less. My supplier network covers all of Abidjan and beyond. From single-family villas to multi-lot developments, I work with your existing quote and bring you the same materials at a far fairer price.
about.guarantee: If I can't beat your quote, I'll tell you honestly.
